# Vendored cn-font-split (WASM-only)

Self-hosted web-font slicing with **zero runtime wasm/fs npm dependencies**.
The fonts domain drives cn-font-split's Rust wasm core via Node's built-in
`node:wasi` (binds `node:fs` directly). The wasm binary is inlined into the
SSR bundle at build time by `vite-plugin-binary`.

cn-font-split is published to npm at `7.4.3` while the Rust core has advanced
to `7.6.8` on GitHub. We pair the Rust wasm binary (7.6.8) with a **minimal
JS glue layer we control** + an **`@bufbuild/protobuf`-based encoder**
generated from the upstream proto schema. The proto schema is the only
contract between JS and the wasm core.

## Files

| File            | Source                                                      | Role                                                        |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `api.proto`     | `crates/proto/src/index.proto` from the `release` branch    | Schema source of truth (the JS↔wasm contract)               |
| `gen/api_pb.ts` | Generated by `pnpm fonts:gen` (protoc + protoc-gen-es)      | `@bufbuild/protobuf` `InputTemplate` encoder (committed)    |
| `cnfs.wasm`     | GitHub release `7.6.8` → `libffi-wasm32-wasip1.wasm`        | The Rust slicing core (sha256 below)                        |
| `wasm-split.ts` | This repo (ported from `packages/ffi-js/src/wasm/index.ts`) | `fontSplit(props)` — node:wasi glue that runs the wasm core |

## Why this shape

- **`node:wasi` instead of `memfs-browser` + `@tybys/wasm-util`**: Node's
  built-in WASI binds `node:fs` directly. We use a real OS temp directory as
  the wasm's `/` — no virtual filesystem, no browser-oriented deps.
- **`vite-plugin-binary`**: Inlines the 4.2 MB `.wasm` as base85-encoded data
  into the SSR bundle at build time. No separate asset file to emit, no
  relative-path resolution at runtime — works equally in dev, test, and
  production.
- **`@bufbuild/protobuf`**: Modern, lightweight protobuf runtime. The encoder
  (`gen/api_pb.ts`) is generated from `api.proto` via `protoc-gen-es` and
  committed, so no `protoc` dependency at build or runtime.

## Updating

### wasm binary (manual)

```sh
curl -L -o src/server/domains/fonts/vendor/cnfs.wasm \
  https://github.com/KonghaYao/cn-font-split/releases/download/<VERSION>/libffi-wasm32-wasip1.wasm
shasum -a 256 src/server/domains/fonts/vendor/cnfs.wasm
```

Record the new sha256 below. The `sliceFont` unit test (real TTF, end-to-end)
is the schema-drift guard — if a new wasm binary breaks the proto contract,
that test fails.

### proto + generated encoder

```sh
pnpm fonts:gen
```

Regenerates `gen/api_pb.ts` from `api.proto` via `protoc-gen-es` (requires
`protoc` on PATH). Commit the regenerated file. Re-fetch `api.proto` from the
upstream `release` branch (`crates/proto/src/index.proto`) if the schema
changes.
